threads.body: Counting only `FunctionSpanData` underreports tool calls: in supported SDK v0.3.3, [`ComputerAction.execute` and `LocalShellAction.execute`](https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/blob/v0.3.3/src/agents/_run_impl.py#L1266-L1424) execute client-side tools without creating function spans. Agents using these tools therefore report zero or partial totals, although the [metric definition](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/blob/main/docs/gen-ai/gen-ai-metrics.md#metric-gen_aiinvoke_agenttool_calls) includes these executions. Observe those execution paths without double-counting function spans, or leave the metric unset when a complete count is unavailable, and add regression coverage.

replies.body: Good catch. I’ve changed this to omit the tool-call metric for agents configured with computer or local-shell tools rather than report an incomplete total. Inference counts remain available.

threads.body: Requiring every configured tool to produce a function span discards valid counts for function-only agents: using one of two tools loses the count of 1, and using neither loses the zero sample. This biases the histogram toward runs that execute every configured tool. Determine completeness from tool types or tracing capabilities rather than whether each tool ran, preserve omission for genuinely unobservable client-side tools, and add regression coverage for unused ordinary function tools.

threads.body: In supported SDK v0.24.0, [`on_llm_start` runs once before the runner's retry helper](https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/blob/v0.24.0/src/agents/run_internal/run_loop.py#L2967-L3042), so a failed model attempt followed by a successful retry records 1 inference call instead of 2. Streaming and exhausted retries are also undercounted, contrary to the [metric definition's inclusion of failed calls](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/blob/main/docs/gen-ai/gen-ai-metrics.md#metric-gen_aiinvoke_agentinference_calls). Count individual model attempts or reconcile retry-aware counts, including terminal failures, and add streaming and non-streaming retry regression tests.

threads.body: semconv defines the inference span as a [logical client call](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/blob/main/docs/gen-ai/client-inference.md#span-gen_aiclientinference), not a per-try one, so `inference_calls` should count logical calls too. `on_llm_start` already does that, so maybe drop the retry-helper patching (`_original_retry_functions`, `_wrap_model_retry`, `count_inference_calls`)? That also removes the dependency on the private `agents.run_internal.run_loop` module.
